verdict.seen: A thin shaft at the left edge in frame 1, then a dark rectangular hole opening sideways in frames 2 and 3, but it sits left of the river, not under it.
verdict.problem: The sideways hole is beside the shaft and does not reach under the river; extend the hole so it opens beneath the river.

verdict.seen: A dark hole with a CAVED IN label, debris at the roof and a blue water column with a flood base flowing into the hole.
A yellow shield with a cutter wheel moves right through the dark bore under the river, with the bore open behind it.
Concrete ring segments line the tunnel walls behind the yellow machine, clearly visible.
Close-up of the yellow boring machine with a yellow outline box around it and the cutter wheel visible.
The wheel sits at the front, and brown mud balls run along the tunnel floor belt toward the shaft over the frames.
Grey smoke puffs appear in the tunnel in frames 2 and 3 after the mud belt is gone.
Small fans appear in the tunnel roof and spin while the smoke puffs shrink and clear across the frames.
Two fans with white arrows in the left and middle of the tunnel, but nothing at the right part near the machine.
verdict.problem: Arrows do not run through the whole tunnel; add fresh-air arrows along the full length.

verdict.seen: A thin yellow road line appears on the floor in frames 2 and 3, but no lights are visible on the ceiling.
verdict.problem: Ceiling lights are missing or unreadable; add clearly visible lights along the ceiling and a more visible road.

verdict.seen: The full scene is in view: house, river, shaft, lined tunnel with the machine and fans, nothing covering it.
